value.message: Town of Oakville runs Learn to Swim Preschool A-E for 3-5 year olds, their site says fall registration opened Aug 11 at 7am. YMCA of Oakville has preschool swim (3-5) and Goldfish Swim School has Junior group lessons (3-4, $32.50 per 30 min). I couldn't get into their pages today, so I'll keep watching and text you what I find.
